notes: Partition verified: 36 source and 43 target ids each placed exactly once.
The appositional *even* is added: rule 16's second family reaches only a marker standing on the very phrase the word introduces, and this appositive carries none.
*every one* is added within this verse, its כֹּל standing in v19; the unit note records the competing assignment to be'ad, which the ASV leaves unrendered under rule 40.
be-lo ka-katuv divides as *otherwise* (preposition plus negative fused, headed on the negative), *than*, *it* (substantival article), *is written*.
